AnalyticsPage.title: Analytics
AnalyticsPage.subtitle: Revenue, pipeline, and team activity at a glance
AnalyticsPage.revenueInfo: Won revenue (realized) vs projected value of all deals, by month.
AnalyticsPage.stageInfo: Open deals in the selected pipeline, by stage. Bar = total value, number = open deals.
AnalyticsPage.winRateInfo: Deals closed this period, won vs lost. Center = win rate (won ÷ won+lost).
AnalyticsPage.activityInfo: Logged activities by type over the period, dated by timestamp.
AnalyticsPage.teamInfo: Members ranked by logged activity: activities, completed tasks, and notes.
AnalyticsPage.agingInfo: Open deals by stage and time since last update. Fresh < 7 days, stalled > 60.
AnalyticsPage.topDealsInfo: Biggest open deals by expected value; biggest wins by actual value.
AnalyticsPage.pipelineValueInfo: Won revenue this period plus current open value, per pipeline. Ranked by total; empty pipelines hidden.
AnalyticsPage.emptyBody: As you add deals and log activity, this page fills in with revenue trends, win rates, pipeline value, and team momentum.

AnalyticsKpis.comparisonNote: Compared with the previous period of equal length. "No prior data" means nothing to compare against.
AnalyticsKpis.wonRevenueTooltip: Actual value of deals won this period, by close date.
AnalyticsKpis.newPipelineTooltip: Expected value of all deals created this period, open or closed. Uses expected value, not the won amount.
AnalyticsKpis.winRateTooltip: Won ÷ (won + lost) for deals closed this period. Deals closed with no win/lose stage aren't counted.
AnalyticsKpis.avgCycleTooltip: Average days from creation to close, for deals won this period.

AnalyticsPipelines.deals: {count, plural, one {# open deal} other {# open deals}}
